Sophie: Hey team - CI turned red on hosted integration for PR #4219, failing intermittently on the streaming/toolcall path. test_toolcall_stream_auth_endtoend fails with 401 then 503 in the same run :grimacing:
Raj: Thanks Sophie. Can you paste the failing shard and a tail of the logs? I can try a quick rerun.
Sophie: Shard 7. Minimal log snippet below:
```
ERROR: Request failed during streaming: status=401
2026-03-17T12:03:05Z auth: token refresh returned 200 but session rejected
... retrying...
ERROR: toolcall handler crashed: upstream returned 503 after 2 retries
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/redwood/runtime/handler.py", line 214, in handle
    resp = await downstream.stream(request)
  File "/srv/redwood/runtime/transport.py", line 98, in stream
    raise UpstreamError("503 Service Unavailable")
UpstreamError: 503 Service Unavailable
```
Sophie: PR commit is 6a2b9f3, last green was 6a2b9f3~3 (so this has been flaky for a few runs).
Linda: Is this only against hosted or do dedicated tests hit it?
Alex: I saw a similar flake yesterday on a local smoke run; suspect intermittent auth handshake + proxy. Might be a routing/regression in the auth proxy helper.
Raj: I'm going to queue a targeted rerun for shard 7 with DEBUG_AUTH=1 and increased timeouts to see if we can capture the handshake: `ci run smoke --pr=4219 --shard=7 --env DEBUG_AUTH=1 --timeout=90s`
ci-bot: Rerun queued by Raj — job id: 9642 — artifacts will appear in ~10m. Link: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/9642
Sophie: Thanks. If that reproduces, can we also try against staging-hosted (same job) to rule out a test harness flake vs hosted infra?
Raj: Good call. I'll run the same job against staging-hosted, tag @Linda in case infra networking needs to check the proxy nodes.
Linda: Ping received, I'll watch the job and check proxy metrics for the time range (auth-service latency, connection drops).
Alex: If rerun is green, still worth running `git bisect` across the last 20 commits that touched auth/proxy. I can start a binary search tomorrow if we still see flakes.
Sophie: For now, marking this PR as blocked on CI rerun/infra checks. If anyone else sees similar flakes on other PRs, please drop them here so we can group. :raised_hands:
ci-bot: Job 9642 started — streaming logs: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/9642/logs
ci-bot: Job 9642 finished — result: flaky (1/3 failures). Artifacts: https://ci.internal.redwood/jobs/9642/artifacts
Raj: Rerun reproduced an auth 401 then 503 within a single session. I captured full auth handshake in the artifacts. Linking to the capture: https://ci.internal.redwood/artifacts/9642/auth-handshake.pcap
Linda: I see spikes on proxy node p-12 around that time, connection resets increased. Opening an infra incident to investigate network flaps and key rotation windows.
Sophie: Thanks everyone. I'll leave the PR blocked until infra confirms. If infra reports no issue, we proceed to bisect.
